entries.title: Player: ""My next plan is to use my emergenc..."

entries.dialogueText: "Next, I will start campaigning for a transition to parliamentary democracy."
entries.menuText: "Next, I will start campaigning for a transition to parliamentary democracy."

entries.title: Player: ""Soon I'll be enacting major reform..."
entries.dialogueText: "Soon I'll be enacting major reforms with my new powers."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian nodded in agreement. Ciara g..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian nodded in agreement. Ciara gave me a mocking stare.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas spread out her arms and look..."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas spread out her arms and looked at me in disbelief.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nia narrowed her eyes skeptically."
entries.dialogueText: Nia narrowed her eyes skeptically.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The cabinet looked at me with curio..."
entries.dialogueText: The cabinet looked at me with curiosity.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""This is getting ridiculous, Mr. Pr..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is getting ridiculous, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""The Constitution is not a toy. You..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Constitution is not a toy. You can't just play with it and change it however you like."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""With all due respect, I believe yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "With all due respect, I believe you are not seeing things clearly anymore, Mr. President. I'm concerned about you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As Petr was about to respond, Gus c..."
entries.dialogueText: As Petr was about to respond, Gus cut in.

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""In this rare occasion, I have to a..."
entries.dialogueText: "In this rare occasion, I have to admit that I agree with Mrs. Graf here. It's important not to get ahead of ourselves."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Sordish reality is quite different..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sordish reality is quite different than what's being said here. Let's not kid ourselves."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""I believe the decision that led to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe the decision that led to these investigations was taken without the counsel of Council of Ministers."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""And there is only one signature on..."
entries.dialogueText: "And there is only one signature on that emergency decree, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr stood up."
entries.dialogueText: Petr stood up.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""What are you trying to say, Mrs. W..."
entries.dialogueText: "What are you trying to say, Mrs. Walda? Don't overstep your boundaries."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""I just don't see how we could be o..."
entries.dialogueText: "I just don't see how we could be of any help under such circumstances."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""And what kind of changes are these?""
entries.dialogueText: "And what kind of changes are these?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I will campaign for the transition..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will campaign for the transition into a parliamentary system."
entries.menuText: "I will campaign for the transition into a parliamentary system."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I will campaign for strengthening..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will campaign for strengthening the executive further."
entries.menuText: "I will campaign for strengthening the executive further."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Your lack of idealism is saddening..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your lack of idealism is saddening. We can't develop if we don't even try."
entries.menuText: "Your lack of idealism is saddening. We can't develop if we don't even try."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nia spread out her arms and looked..."
entries.dialogueText: Nia spread out her arms and looked at me in disbelief. Just as she was about to speak, Lileas jumped in.

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""With all due respect, I believe yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "With all due respect, I believe you are not seeing things clearly anymore, Mr. President. I'm concerned about you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We will continue our privatization..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will continue our privatization and fully integrate Sordland into the free market."
entries.menuText: "We will continue our privatization and fully integrate Sordland into the free market."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The presidential system is flawed...."
entries.dialogueText: "The presidential system is flawed. Look at our history."
entries.menuText: "The presidential system is flawed. Look at our history."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I will hear no discussions. This w..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will hear no discussions. This will be our focus."
entries.menuText: "I will hear no discussions. This will be our focus."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""This is getting ridiculous, Mr. Pr..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is getting ridiculous, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""The Constitution is not a toy. You..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Constitution is not a toy. You can't just play with it and change it however you like."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As Petr was about to respond, Nia c..."
entries.dialogueText: As Petr was about to respond, Nia cut in.

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""In this rare occasion, I have to a..."
entries.dialogueText: "In this rare occasion, I have to admit that I agree with Mrs. Graf here. It's important not to get ahead of ourselves."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I cannot let this country be shape..."
entries.dialogueText: "I cannot let this country be shaped according to one man's ideals again."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I will hear no discussions. This w..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will hear no discussions. This will be our focus."
entries.menuText: "I will hear no discussions. This will be our focus."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You can try to stop me. Don't forg..."
entries.dialogueText: "You can try to stop me. Don't forget that you are working for me."
entries.menuText: "You can try to stop me. Don't forget that you are working for me."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You are hurting me, Mrs. Morgna. D..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are hurting me, Mrs. Morgna. Do you really see me as an authoritarian?"
entries.menuText: "You are hurting me, Mrs. Morgna. Do you really see me as an authoritarian?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We will continue our nationalizati..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will continue our nationalization and fully take control of the means of production."
entries.menuText: "We will continue our nationalization and fully take control of the means of production."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""More social policies.""
entries.dialogueText: "More social policies."
entries.menuText: "More social policies."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We will pursue the nationalization..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will pursue the nationalization of the means of production."
entries.menuText: "We will pursue the nationalisation of the means of production."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We will pursue further free market..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will pursue further free market reforms."
entries.menuText: "We will pursue further free market reforms."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I see.""
entries.dialogueText: "I see."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I see. Further destruction of our..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see. Further destruction of our economy."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Deivid looked at Gus."
entries.dialogueText: Deivid looked at Gus.

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""Mr. President is right.""
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President is right."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I see. Very Bold.""
entries.dialogueText: "I see. Very Bold."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Maybe too bold.""
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe too bold."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""I fully support rewriting the whol..."
entries.dialogueText: "I fully support rewriting the whole Constitution and establish a more democratic parliamentary system in Sordland."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you for your support, Mr. Wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for your support, Mr. Wisci."
entries.menuText: "Thank you for your support, Mr. Wisci."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nobody responded. Nia was furious."
entries.dialogueText: Nobody responded. Nia was furious.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He smiled. Nobody else responded."
entries.dialogueText: He smiled. Nobody else responded.

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Yes, Mr. President. I will no long..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Mr. President. I will no longer be silent about it."

entries.title: Player: ""We'll talk about this later, Mrs...."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll talk about this later, Mrs. Morgna. Let's move on for now, shall we?"

entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""You are showing the tendency, Mr...."
entries.dialogueText: "You are showing the tendency, Mr. President."

entries.dialogueText: "Frankly, I don't care. I've told you our focus and that's it."
entries.menuText: "Frankly, I don't care. I've told you our focus and that's it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She did not respond."
entries.dialogueText: She did not respond.

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Whatever you say, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "Whatever you say, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Let's not argue about this now, Mr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's not argue about this now, Mrs. Graf."
entries.menuText: "Let's not argue about this now, Mrs. Graf."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""Whatever you say, *Mr. President*.""
entries.dialogueText: "Whatever you say, *Mr. President*."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Why can't you be more like Lucian,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why can't you be more like Lucian, Mrs. Walda?"
entries.menuText: "Why can't you be more like Lucian, Mrs. Walda?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian nodded in agreement."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian nodded in agreement.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Frankly, I don't care what you thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Frankly, I don't care what you think. Our focus has been decided."
entries.menuText: "Frankly, I don't care what you think. Our focus has been decided."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian stepped up."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian stepped up.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I'm already working on it, Mr. Pre..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm already working on it, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you Lucian. Please make sure..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you Lucian. Please make sure the whole team is on the same page with us."
entries.menuText: "Thank you Lucian. Please make sure the whole team is on the same page with us."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I will be using my powers to their..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will be using my powers to their limits."
entries.menuText: "I will be using my powers to their limits."

entries.speaker: Ciara Walda
entries.title: Ciara Walda: ""With all due respect, I'm not goin..."
entries.dialogueText: "With all due respect, I'm not going to respond to that."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Frankly, I don't care what you thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Frankly, I don't care what you think. We have bigger problems here."
entries.menuText: "Frankly, I don't care what you think. We have bigger problems here."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian nodded. Nobody else responde..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian nodded. Nobody else responded.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""Yes sir. It is of utmost importanc..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes sir. It is of utmost importance."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Iosef stood up."
entries.dialogueText: Iosef stood up.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I want Mrs. Graf to put the region..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want Mrs. Graf to put the region of Bergia under heavy surveillance."
entries.menuText: "I want Mrs. Graf to put the region of Bergia under heavy surveillance."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I want to establish peace talks wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want to establish peace talks with the group."
entries.menuText: "I want to establish peace talks with the group."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""As you wish.""
entries.dialogueText: "As you wish."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""Sir, I would advise against it. Th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sir, I would advise against it. They are our enemies."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I want you to just try and reach o..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want you to just try and reach out to them. We should be diplomatic."
entries.menuText: "I want you to just try and reach out to them. We should be diplomatic."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""I can't believe you are justifying..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't believe you are justifying the murders of our Sordish citizens."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian stepped up."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian stepped up.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I'll look into it, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll look into it, sir."

entries.speaker: Lileas Graf
entries.title: Lileas Graf: ""So we're going to sit on a table w..."
entries.dialogueText: "So we're going to sit on a table with murderers now? No deal will benefit those who died in their acts of terror."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""They are fighting us because the s..."
entries.dialogueText: "They are fighting us because the state has never listened to them before."
entries.menuText: "They are fighting us because the state has never listened to them before."
